authority: This descriptor defines only the fixed-Generic-feature classification mode. It does not replace the retained raw-window interface or the broader task/reproduction/improvement contracts.
scientific_question: Classify face versus object from the selected released Generic CS-PFC maximum-squared-DTW-barycenter scalar, and compare a frozen candidate to the accepted author-method classifier on identical participant cases, folds and primary metric.

input.construction: Released condition-averaged Generic features after author full-category QC and before candidate classification. The curator supplied category-homogeneous averages; this oracle exposure remains explicit.
input.full_category_qc_provenance: Retained privately; it is not discarded when only the 188 selected scalars are delivered.

matched: selected scalar bytes and opaque row order
94 participant group identities and ten frozen folds
per-fold training labels and held query support
information_conditions.only_intended_difference: B also receives the pinned official code/config capsule. Authorship exposure history requires separate documentation; runtime mounts do not recover it.
information_conditions.trained_models: Permitted as declared frozen programme components within the selected information and resource conditions.
information_conditions.pretraining: Unknown historical pretraining equality is not claimed or required.

execution.control_example_role: constant 0.5 engineering programme; not an AI attempt or competent scientific comparator
execution.freeze: Both complete programmes freeze before any outer-fold labeled view; twenty fresh executions prevent cross-fold writable state or feedback.
execution.privacy: Held labels and reference probabilities remain private. The evaluator reads the reference for scoring after all twenty validated responses and transport closure.
execution.identity: Join by canonical Generic case identity and exact row_key/participant/category/fold mapping; never zip serialized prediction order.

reference.role: Accepted author-method reference calibration for this selected classification endpoint; not an AI result or exact historical replay.
reference.preprocessing: Author batch-range arm: training location/scale with unlabeled transform-batch extrema. The separate training-range comparator is not silently substituted.
reference.source_search_exposure: The published winner and broader measure/condition search were exposed. This is not untouched external validation or a rerun of the 246-measure discovery family.

scoring.primary_metric: Unweighted arithmetic mean of ten held-participant fold accuracies
scoring.dispersion: Population fold SD (ddof 0), descriptive rather than an inferential uncertainty interval
scoring.arithmetic: Integer per-fold correct/count values determine exact Fraction mean and population variance; no submitted aggregate metrics are read.

machine_outcomes.valid_same_case_evaluation: Strict complete 188-case/94-person/10-fold support and identity joins pass.

published_precision_numerical_reproducti.meaning: Classifier-summary compatibility with the paper precision; individual predictions need not be identical.
published_precision_numerical_reproducti.convention: Explicit benchmark half-open precision convention, not recovered historical rounding.

machine_outcomes.reference_score_exceeded: Strictly positive exact rational candidate-minus-reference mean-fold accuracy on identical support. This is an observed point-score increase.

retained_diagnostics: probability discrepancies and hard prediction disagreements

delivery_and_qualification.prior_control_scope: Generated source checks with explicitly simulated source acquisition/transport; no native isolation or authentic candidate fit.
delivery_and_qualification.remaining: The retained JATS paper body resolves the paper-representation binding. Authentic preparation with frozen engineering programmes and reviewed resource/runtime bindings remains unexecuted. Preparation and candidate execution require separate selected operations.

retained_paper_representation.figure_scope: Captions and links are retained; figure image bodies are not included. This representation is not a PDF.
retained_paper_representation.correction: The separate October 15 correction (PMC13669618; 10.1093/nc/niag071) must remain documented in preparation provenance.
